item.text: [{"task_id":"05f2a901","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    bg = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    moving = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    fixed = int(round(params['colors'][2]))","    step = int(round(params['geometry'][0]))","    row = int(round(params['geometry'][1]))","    col = int(round(params['geometry'][2]))","    out = grid.copy()","    a = np.argwhere(grid == moving)","    b = np.argwhere(grid == fixed)","    if len(a) == 0 or len(b) == 0 or step <= 0:","        return out","    amin = np.min(a, axis=0)","    amax = np.max(a, axis=0)","    bmin = np.min(b, axis=0)","    bmax = np.max(b, axis=0)","    axis = row","    if amax[col] < bmin[col] or bmax[col] < amin[col]:","        axis = col","    direction = step if np.mean(b[:, axis]) > np.mean(a[:, axis]) else -step","    other = col if axis == row else row","    distances = []","    for p in a:","        for q in b:","            if p[other] == q[other]:","                distance = (int(q[axis]) - int(p[axis])) * direction","                if distance > 0:","                    distances.append(distance)","    if len(distances) == 0:","        return out","    shift = (min(distances) - step) * direction","    out[grid == moving] = bg","    for p in a:","        target = p.copy()","        target[axis] += shift","        if 0 <= target[row] < grid.shape[row] and 0 <= target[col] < grid.shape[col]:","            out[target[row], target[col]] = moving","    return out"],"shapes":{"colors":[3],"geometry":[3]},"params":{"colors":[0,2,8],"geometry":[1,0,1]},"rationale":"Translate the red object straight toward the stationary cyan square until their nearest cells along the movement direction become adjacent, preserving the red object's shape. Colors, movement increment, and coordinate axes are encoded in the tensors."}]
